Implemented the fix in `hugolib/content_map_page.go:379`.

The non-recursive section walk previously tracked only one "other branch" prefix. With lexically adjacent names like `s1` and `s1-foo`, that prefix was overwritten, causing descendants of the earlier branch to leak into `.Pages`. The walk now tracks all encountered branch prefixes and skips descendants of each.
